label: AlteringCave_1F_Text_Researcher
text:
This cavern feels like a doorway.
The deeper I go, the stranger it\lbecomes.\pHOOPA lives among the wild
POKéMON here. Each encounter\lhas a 3% chance of being HOOPA.\pMEWTWO waits on B1F. It accepts
challengers with the MIND BADGE.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafAfter
text: LEAF: Take this MEWTWONITE X. It\ncan help MEWTWO Mega Evolve.\pIf you meet it here, I hope the\ntwo of you can learn to trust each\lother.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoDormant
text: MEWTWO is watching you. Return\nwith the MIND BADGE to challenge\lit.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoNeedsPartner
text: MEWTWO accepts challengers with\nthe MIND BADGE. No partner\lspecies is required.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoAwakens
text: MEWTWO steps forward to challenge\nyou!$

label: AshenWoods_Text_MartinAfter
text: MOLTRES roosts in EMBER PATH.\nFollow the trail and keep your eyes\lup. Those feathers catch the light!$

label: AshenWoods_Text_Caretaker
text:
Heat scorched these woods, but the
roots survived. See the new leaves?\pWith the weather changing so much,
POKéMON we seldom saw are appearing\lamong the ash.\pThe old wardens say RAYQUAZA keeps
land and sea in balance. I hope\lthey are right.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CircuitRewardPending
text: Your reward remains recorded.\pReview this Pokémon's legendary lead\nfor any remaining conditions.\pYour wins will not be lost.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenGoldMons
text:
Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN
when he's serious?\pWhen he throws his entire might into
battle, he's said to use these POKéMON:\pA FIRE-type LEGENDARY POKéMON,
a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON,\land a WATER-type AURORA POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
text:
Oh, it's adorable! Thank you! I
promise I'll be good to it.\pTYPE: NULL already has a battle
set. Raise its friendship, then\llevel it up to get SILVALLY.\pA memory held by SILVALLY changes
its type.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
text: Whaaaaaat?! Pfft!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way\nbecause my cheering was so loud!\lThat old tournament was legendary!$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
text:
Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}. STEVEN told me
how far you have traveled.\pI am WALLACE. I once led the
SOOTOPOLIS GYM; JUAN leads it\lnow.\pGROUDON and KYOGRE's powers are
overwhelming HOENN. Their\lstruggle will consume land and\lsea alike.\pThe oldest tale tells of a third
power that stopped their clash:\lRAYQUAZA.\pWe need its help again. But I do
not know where it sleeps...$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
text: WALLACE: The elders at MT. PYRE\ntold me RAYQUAZA's story, but it\ldoesn't rest there.\pPerhaps another place high above\nthe sea?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceAfter
text: WALLACE: What a pleasure to battle\nyou here! The crystals seemed to\lcatch every flash of light.\pYou needn't win an exhibition to\nmeet DIANCIE or find the DIANCITE\lhere. Take your time exploring!$

label: CeruleanCave_B1F_Text_Mew
text: Mew!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_LegendaryBirdEmail
text:
There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…$

label: DewfordMeadow_Text_Warden
text:
COSMOG and MUNKIDORI live in
this meadow. Each has a 3%\lchance of appearing in the grass.\pMELOETTA answers songs. With the
KNUCKLE BADGE, bring a partner\lwith SING and we will perform\ltogether.\pOnce it answers, you can search
for it here. We only need to\lsing together once.\pSWEET SCENT helps find MELOETTA
after our song. All available\llocal legendaries share its\l25% chance.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Welcome. I am PHOEBE.\pI trained on MT. PYRE, where the ones
who are gone still take part.\pMy friends can steal your boosts
and wear down your strength with burns.\pKeep something for SPECTRIER.
Each knockout can make it stronger.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
text: TORNADUS gives TAILWIND priority.\nBRAVIARY rides the gust behind it.\pFour turns. Outlast them!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
text:
Six badges! STERN and DEVON have
approved your exploration trips.\pHere are passes for the ferry,
SOUTHERN ISLAND, NAVEL ROCK,\lBIRTH ISLAND and FARAWAY ISLAND.\pThe BATTLE FRONTIER is open too.
Its CIRCUIT awards legendary\lPOKéMON as your total wins grow.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ChampionPassesReady
text: Your island routes are active.\nShow the attendant a pass to\lchoose a destination.\pExplore for LATIAS or LATIOS,\nLUGIA, HO-OH, DEOXYS and MEW. You\lcan meet them during your GYM\ljourney.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_LatiReport
text:
I've received two sightings: red
LATIAS and blue LATIOS!\pOne will travel HOENN's routes.
The other waits on SOUTHERN\lISLAND.\pWhich mainland lead shall we
follow: red or blue?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_LatiReportReady
text: Red is LATIAS; blue is LATIOS.\pWatch the routes for your choice,\nand sail to meet the other!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
text: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON\nfrom long ago.\pThe artist painted this from\nimagination.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardWaiting
text: PROF. BIRCH: Your LEGENDARY FORM tools\nare still here. Let's finish the set.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardComplete
text: The tools let KYUREM, ZYGARDE,\nNECROZMA, and CALYREX change\lforms or combine with certain\lpartners.\pThere's always something new to\nlearn about POKéMON!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
text: None of us have seen GROUDON.\nMAXIE keeps the last chamber\lclosed.\pThe mountain's shaking. I hope he\nknows what he's doing.$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
text: Can you feel the mountain\nshaking? That's GROUDON's power!\pMAXIE's waited years for this. I\nwon't let you spoil it!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
text: This is the last chamber. GROUDON\nis just beyond us.\pYou want to stop MAXIE? You'll\nhave to get past me!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
text:
TABITHA: You've made it through
the entire hideout. I should have\lexpected it.\pMAXIE is with GROUDON. This is
the moment we've worked for.\pI'm not letting you take it from
us!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
text: MAXIE: GROUDON, ancient architect\nof continents... accept the BLUE\lORB.\pThe mountain shakes with your\npower. Rise, and give HOENN land\lthat will never yield!$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
text: MAXIE: GROUDON! What's wrong? The\nBLUE ORB was supposed to awaken\lyou!\pWait! Where are you going?$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
text:
MAXIE: GROUDON is loose. I have
to find out why the ORB failed to\lcontrol it.\pARCHIE still has the RED ORB.
He'll need STERN's submarine to\lreach KYOGRE on the seafloor.\pGo warn CAPT. STERN at the harbor
in northeast SLATEPORT.\pI'm going after GROUDON.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
text:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!\pWATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it
up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL.\lThe generator can be on or off!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
text: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pIt pleases me to no end to see\nthe young step up and take charge!\pWATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it\nup in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL.\lThe generator can be on or off!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
text:
With the FEATHER BADGE and
REGIROCK recorded as caught,\lREGIDRAGO can appear on this\lfloor.\pIt has a 1% wild encounter
chance. SWEET SCENT raises that\lto 25%.\pFALLARBOR's CENTER guide knows
the discoveries in the other\lMETEOR FALLS rooms.$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
text: MANAPHY and PALKIA live on the\nSEAFLOOR CAVERN seabed.\pDIVE at ROUTE 128 and search near\nthe submarine. Each has a 3%\lwild encounter chance.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
text: GOTHITELLE closes the exit. AZELF\nplots, and then ends the board.\pYou cannot run from this one!$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
text: LATIAS can recover and use CALM MIND.\nDon't let a long battle favor it.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
text: LATIOS is quick, and AEGISLASH\ncan make a careless attack\lcostly.\pChoose your moment!$

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
text: MAXIE: Keep the fuel. We're\nleaving.\pI must find GROUDON, and stop\nARCHIE before he awakens KYOGRE.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntDormant
text: PECHARUNT waits here. Earn the\nMIND BADGE and catch OKIDOGI,\lMUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI to\lchallenge it.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntNeedsPartner
text: The three masks belong to OKIDOGI,\nMUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI.\pCatch all three, then return here.\nThey do not need to travel with you.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntAwakens
text: The three masks flare! A poisoned mist\nspills from the tombstone--PECHARUNT!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiQuiet
text: The nightmare has lifted. Your\nencounter with DARKRAI is\lrecorded.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiAwakened
text: DARKRAI emerges from the\nnightmare mist. Approach it at\lthe summit.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiAwaits
text: DARKRAI is still waiting in the\nnightmare mist at the summit.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_CresseliaAwakened
text: DARKRAI's capture has revealed a\nnew lead: CRESSELIA shelters in\lthe rear B1F room of METEOR\lFALLS.\pWith six badges and our ORB, it\ncan appear among wild POKéMON\lthere.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_CresseliaAwaits
text: CRESSELIA can appear among wild\nPOKéMON in METEOR FALLS' rear B1F\lroom, after six badges and our\lORB.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_TimeSignDormant
text: DIALGA lives in the main B1F\nchamber of METEOR FALLS. It has\la 3% wild encounter chance.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DialgaAwakened
text: DIALGA can appear among wild\nPOKéMON in the main B1F chamber\lof METEOR FALLS. Its chance is 3%.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DialgaAwaits
text: Search the main B1F chamber of\nMETEOR FALLS for DIALGA. Each\lwild encounter has a 3% chance.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
text:
Both ORBS are gone. They were
entrusted to us to keep GROUDON\land KYOGRE's powers in balance.\pMAGMA dropped this EMBLEM. Take
it to their hideout in JAGGED\lPASS.\pRide ROUTE 112's cable car to MT.
CHIMNEY, then descend the pass.\pCarry the EMBLEM near the odd
boulder on the east side. It may\lopen the way.\pStop MAGMA before they awaken
something they cannot control.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
text:
The stolen ORBS can awaken
GROUDON and KYOGRE. Their powers\lmust never clash again.\pTake the MAGMA EMBLEM to JAGGED
PASS. Use ROUTE 112's cable car\lto MT. CHIMNEY, then descend the\lpass.\pApproach the strange boulder on
the east side. Find MAGMA before\lthey awaken GROUDON.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
text:
Both GROUDON and KYOGRE are
awake? Then we are all in danger.\pThe ORBS are part of their
ancient bond. They are no\lguarantee of obedience.\pOnly RAYQUAZA stopped their last
clash. You must find someone who\lknows where it rests.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
text:
GROUDON raised the land and
KYOGRE carved the sea. Their\lclash grew until neither could\lstop.\pRAYQUAZA descended and calmed
them. The RED and BLUE ORBS were\lleft in our care.\pTAPU LELE and Galarian MOLTRES
live in the outside grass.\lGIRATINA lives on the sixth floor.\lEach has a 3% encounter chance.\pReceiving our ORB and earning
six badges lets you find YVELTAL\loutside, too. SWEET SCENT helps\lwith that discovery.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
text: Our old tale tells how RAYQUAZA\nstopped a terrible clash. Now we\lhave seen it happen again.\pWill you hear what people are\nsaying about SOOTOPOLIS?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
text: RAYQUAZA restored the balance.\nYou helped HOENN find a way\lthrough.\pSearch the sixth floor for\nGIRATINA. It has a 3% wild\lencounter chance.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsApart
text: The ORBS were entrusted to us to\nkeep GROUDON and KYOGRE's powers\lin balance.\pOnly RAYQUAZA could calm their\nlast clash. I fear we will need\lits help again.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomCaught
text:
The ROTOM CATALOG changes ROTOM
into its five appliances.\pMELTAN lives among this plant's
wild POKéMON, at 3%.\pWith five badges, finish
WATTSON's generator job and\lreport back to add ZERAORA.\lCatch REGISTEEL for REGIELEKI.\pThe FEATHER BADGE then adds
ZEKROM. These three have 1%\lchances; SWEET SCENT gives 25%,\lshared with all local legendaries.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosDormant
text: ZAPDOS watches over the\ngenerator. Return with the\lBALANCE BADGE to challenge it.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosNeedsPartner
text: ZAPDOS accepts challengers with\nthe BALANCE BADGE. No partner\lspecies is required.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosAwakens
text: ZAPDOS crackles with electricity!\nIt accepts your challenge!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
text: FOREST FIELD NOTES\pCUT opens paths into the deeper\nforest. CELEBI lives in the\lthird area.\pVIRIZION and WO-CHIEN live in\nthe second area. Each of these\llegendaries has a 3% wild\lencounter chance in its habitat.$

label: PetalburgWoods_3_Text_Ranger
text: CELEBI has been slipping between\nthe trees. You can find it in\lthis grove's grass, with a 3%\lencounter chance.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscoveredMonMew
text: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMewtwo
text: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.$

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
text:
MAY: That's a DOWSING MACHINE. It
reacts to hidden items.\pFor legendary POKéMON, ask the
guide near a POKéMON CENTER's PC.\lThey know the local leads.\pI'm heading north to MAUVILLE.
WATTSON's GYM is there. See you!$

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
text:
BRENDAN: A DOWSING MACHINE! It
hums near items you can't see.\pThe guide near each POKéMON
CENTER's PC knows local legendary\lPOKéMON and where to find them.\pKeep north to MAUVILLE CITY.
WATTSON's GYM will test your\lteam.$

label: Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign
text:
ROUTE 110: MAUVILLE CITY to the
north.\pRAIKOU and TAPU KOKO live in
this grass, at 3% each.\pWith five badges, rescuing the
WEATHER INSTITUTE adds THUNDURUS.\lIt has a 1% chance. SWEET SCENT\lgives a shared 25% chance among\lall available local legendaries.$

label: Route111_RuinsExterior_Text_Archaeologist
text:
The storms leave strange patterns
across these ruins. LANDORUS may\lbe sheltering here.\pWith the BALANCE BADGE, bring
CASTFORM and help me survey the\lweather.\pThen LANDORUS can appear among
the wild POKéMON here. Our work\lonly needs doing once.$

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
text: MT. CHIMNEY\pFor LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\nplease take the CABLE CAR.\pFIELD NOTE: ENTEI lives in\nFIERY PATH. Each wild encounter\lthere has a 3% chance.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
text:
Oh... Be careful! I was digging
when the wall fell into an\lenormous cavern.\pTING-LU lives in the DESERT
UNDERPASS. It also connects to\lSANDSTREWN RUINS, where ZYGARDE\llives on B1F.\pEach has a 3% wild encounter
chance in its habitat.$

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
text:
Aren't these flowers pretty? I
love watching the POKéMON wander\lthrough them.\pLately, an odd one with a metal
mask has been hiding in the grass.\lDEVON calls it TYPE: NULL.\pWith the KNUCKLE BADGE, you can
search for it here. It's very\lrare, but SWEET SCENT helps draw\lit out.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
text:
CASTFORM changes with the
weather. Let it show you what a\lstorm can do.\pNow that our work can continue,
five badges let you find TORNADUS\lon ROUTE 119 and THUNDURUS on\lROUTE 110.\pSearch their grass. Each has a 1%
chance; SWEET SCENT gives 25%,\lshared with other local legends.\pA researcher at ROUTE 111's
elevated ruins also needs\lCASTFORM for a weather survey.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_RevealGlassPurpose
text: This REVEAL GLASS changes the forms of\nTORNADUS, THUNDURUS, and LANDORUS.\pThe northern bridge is clear now.\nFollow ROUTE 119 to FORTREE's GYM.$

label: Route120_Text_RouteSignFortree
text: ROUTE 120: FORTREE CITY to the\nwest.\pMESPRIT, OGERPON, XERNEAS and\nGalarian ARTICUNO live in this\lgrass, at 3% each.$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle
text: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaNoRoom
text: The sealed prototype answers DIANCIE,\nbut your party and PC have no room.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardNoRoom
text: ARCEUS has answered your journey,\nbut needs room. Please make space\lin your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardComplete
text: Even ARCEUS has joined your\njourney. Take your discoveries to\lthe LEAGUE!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_MegaGift_MAGEARNITE_Text
text: Eight badges! You have seen things\nour laboratory can only dream of.\pThis stone responds to Magearna.\nPerhaps you can learn why.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
text:
The POKéNAV maps HOENN and keeps
you in touch with key Trainers.\pFor legendary leads, visit the
guide near the POKéMON CENTER PC.\pEach town's guide knows nearby
Pokémon and their requirements.\pPlease rest before you leave.
DEWFORD is your next stop.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
text: You'll find STEVEN in GRANITE\nCAVE near DEWFORD. He loses track\lof time studying rocks!\pFor local legendary leads, ask\nthe guide near the PC in any\lPOKéMON CENTER.$

label: SandstrewnRuins_Text_Archaeologist
text: Every fossil here tells us how a\nPOKéMON lived. Imagine this place\lbefore the desert!\pThose green lights below us may\nbe ZYGARDE. Search B1F. It has\la 3% wild encounter chance.$

label: ScorchedSlab_B2F_Text_Warden
text: A white dragon has been glimpsed\namong these hot stones. RESHIRAM!\pIt lives here, with a 3% wild\nencounter chance. HEATRAN dwells\lfarther below.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
text: ARCHIE: What?!\pI didn't do anything.\nWhy did the RED ORB…\pWhere did KYOGRE go?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
text:
ARCHIE: Heavy rain? Good! KYOGRE
is expanding the sea!\pWhat? The routes are flooding?
Our own crews are trapped?\pTell them to get to high ground!
How can the rain still be getting\lworse?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
text: ARCHIE: The RED ORB woke KYOGRE.\nWhy won't it answer me now?\pI never wanted people to get\nhurt…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
text: MAXIE: ARCHIE! KYOGRE's rain is\nspreading, and GROUDON's heat is\lgetting worse.\pIf they meet, the people and\nPOKéMON of HOENN will be caught\lbetween them!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
text: ARCHIE: You're the one who woke\nGROUDON!\pI thought the ORB would let me\ncontrol KYOGRE. But it's not\llistening. Neither of them is!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoDormant
text: ARTICUNO rests in the frozen\nchamber. Return with the FEATHER\lBADGE to challenge it.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoNeedsPartner
text: ARTICUNO accepts challengers with\nthe FEATHER BADGE. No partner\lspecies is required.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoAwakens
text: ARTICUNO spreads its icy wings!\nIt accepts your challenge!$

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
text: RAYQUAZA flew toward SOOTOPOLIS!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
text: GROUDON and KYOGRE…\nWhere did they go?\pWill they cause droughts or downpours\nsomewhere else?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
text: MAXIE: GROUDON, stop!\pI wanted more land for people and\nPOKéMON to live on. You're\lburning the homes they already\lhave!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
text: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! I called this freedom,\nbut even the sea needs a shore.\pThe RED ORB cannot make you hear me.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
text:
STEVEN: GROUDON and KYOGRE's
clash is tearing through this\lcrater.\pTheir weather reaches across
HOENN. We must restore the\lbalance before anyone else is\lhurt.\pWALLACE knows the old legends.
Come with me.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
text: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…\pJust as the old tale said, it\nstopped their clash. You reached\lit in time, {PLAYER}.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
text:
STEVEN: MAXIE and ARCHIE have
gone to MT. PYRE to return the\lORBS.\pThe weather is settling. There is
still so much of HOENN to\lexplore, and so many POKéMON to\lmeet.\pThe guide near the POKéMON
CENTER's PC can tell you about\llocal legendary discoveries.$

label: EmeraldChampions_Text_KubfuInfo
text: A Dark Scroll and a Water Scroll\nlead KUBFU to different styles.\pThis second partner lets you explore\nboth paths with your original KUBFU.$

label: EmeraldChampions_Text_CosmogInfo
text: COSMOEM evolves into SOLGALEO by\nday or LUNALA at night.\pThis second COSMOG lets you\nexplore both paths. Use your\lLeveler when ready.$

label: EmeraldChampions_Text_DeoxysResearch
text: Would you like to study your DEOXYS\nwith our form-changing equipment?$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WillYouHearMyTale
text: I'm the STORYTELLER.\nI'll tell you tales of legendary\lTRAINERS.\pWill you hear my tale?$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IKnowNoTales
text: But, I know of no legendary TRAINERS.\nHence, I know no tales.\pWhere does one find a TRAINER worthy\nof a legendary tale?$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouAnyLegendaryTales
text: Are you a TRAINER?\pThen tell me, have you any tales that\nare even remotely legendary?$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearAnotherLegendaryTale
text: Incidentally… Would you care to hear\nanother legendary tale?$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IWishMorePeopleWereInterested
text: I wish more people would be interested\nin hearing my epic tales of legendary\lTRAINERS.$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BerriesPlantedStory
text:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.\pThis TRAINER planted BERRIES
{STR_VAR_1} times!\p{STR_VAR_3} is a legendary lover of
BERRIES!$
